seo.title: 4-Day Desert Tour from Agadir to Marrakech | Merzouga & Taroudant (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €395 pp. 4-day private desert tour from Agadir to Marrakech. Anti-Atlas scenic drive, Taroudant, Erg Chebbi camel trek, Sahara camp & Ait Ben Haddou.
seo.lead: A 4-day private desert and cultural route from the Atlantic beach city of Agadir to Marrakech. The itinerary crosses the saffron fields of Taliouine and the Anti-Atlas range to Ouarzazate, ventures deep into the Sahara for a sunset camel trek across the Erg Chebbi dunes in Merzouga, and crosses the High Atlas via Tizi n'Tichka into Marrakech.
seo.primaryKeyword: 4 day desert tour from Agadir to Marrakech

price.label: From EUR 395 per person
price.note: Price includes private air-conditioned transport from Agadir, licensed Berber driver-guide, 2 nights in authentic boutique riads/hotels (Dades Valley & Ouarzazate/Taroudant), 1 night in Erg Chebbi desert bivouac, sunset camel trek, dinners, and daily breakfasts.

seo.imageAlt: Camel trekking in the golden dunes of Merzouga on a 4-day desert expedition from Agadir to Marrakech
highlights: Depart from Agadir and explore the ancient ramparts and silver markets of Taroudant ('Little Marrakech')
Drive through the rugged Anti-Atlas mountains and the Berber saffron capital of Taliouine
Trek by camel across the golden Erg Chebbi dunes for sunset and panoramic Sahara views
Spend a memorable night in a private desert camp with Berber folk music and stargazing by the campfire
Walk between the towering 300-meter sheer cliffs of the breathtaking Todra Gorges
Tour the legendary UNESCO World Heritage Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou before descending into Marrakech

faqs.question: Can this tour collect us from our hotel or resort in Agadir or Taghazout?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your private driver-guide picks you up directly from your beach resort, hotel, or private villa in Agadir, Taghazout, or Tamraght at approximately 08:00 AM on Day 1.

faqs.question: Is this itinerary a good way to travel from Agadir to Marrakech without flying?
faqs.answer: Yes. Instead of a direct highway transfer or domestic flight, this 4-day route transforms your transfer into an unforgettable expedition through Taroudant, the Anti-Atlas, the Sahara dunes, and the High Atlas Mountains.

faqs.question: What is the driving terrain and road quality between Agadir and Merzouga?
faqs.answer: The roads are fully paved and well-maintained throughout the route. Our modern air-conditioned 4x4s and minivans provide smooth comfort across the mountain passes and desert plateaus with frequent scenic refreshment stops.

faqs.question: What desert camp amenities are included at Erg Chebbi?
faqs.answer: Your Sahara stay includes private comfortable bedding, authentic Moroccan dinner, and breakfast. Luxury camp options with private ensuite bathrooms, hot showers, and electrical outlets are available on request.

faqs.question: Where does the tour conclude in Marrakech?
faqs.answer: On Day 4, you arrive in Marrakech by early evening (around 18:00 to 19:00). Your driver delivers you directly to your medina riad, hotel, or Marrakech Menara Airport (RAK).
